title: Ripple adder gate list
statement: For each natural number $n$, define the gate list to be the list of gates up to position $	ext{⌊}n/3	ext{⌋}$ with parameter $k=	ext{⌊}n/3	ext{⌋}$, followed by a NOT gate reading the carry input index at that position and an AND gate reading the accumulator index there and the vertex $n+2+15	ext{⌊}n/3	ext{⌋}$.
